# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(clustree)
library(scater)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Perform data integration using *Seurat*

## Prepare the datasets for integration

```{r}
seu <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024",
                     "Gerli_et_al_2024.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds"))

# use the provided integrated assay
seu_int <- seu
DefaultAssay(seu_int) <- "integrated"

seu_int <- RunPCA(seu_int, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
seu_int <- RunUMAP(seu_int, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)

combined_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "combined_metadata.csv"))
rownames(combined_metadata) <- combined_metadata$Sample

cols_to_add <- setdiff(colnames(seu_int@meta.data), colnames(combined_metadata))

seu_int@meta.data <- cbind(seu_int@meta.data[,cols_to_add], 
                           combined_metadata[seu_int@meta.data$Donor,])

dim(seu_int)

# remove cells annotated as HIGH_MITO or DOUBLETS
seu_int <- seu_int[, which(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "HIGH_MITO")]
seu_int <- seu_int[, which(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting != "DOUBLET_LYMPHOID_MACROPHAGE")]

dim(seu_int)
```

# Perform clustering using *Seurat*

```{r}
object <- here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024",
               "Gerli_et_al_2024.Integrated_clustered_all_res.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  seu_int <- FindNeighbors(seu_int, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  seu_int <- FindClusters(seu_int, algorithm = 3, 
                         resolution = seq(0.01, 0.1, by = 0.01))
  seu_int <- RunUMAP(seu_int, dims = 1:30)
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r, fig.asp=1.5}
clustree(seu_int, prefix = "integrated_snn_res.")
```

```{r, fig.asp=1}
DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.01") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS[unique(seu_int$integrated_snn_res.0.01)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend

DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.04") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS[unique(seu_int$integrated_snn_res.0.04)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend

DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.05") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS[unique(seu_int$integrated_snn_res.0.05)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend

DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.1") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS[unique(seu_int$integrated_snn_res.0.1)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend
```

A resolution of 0.04 looks best.

```{r}
seu_int$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seu_int$integrated_snn_res.0.04)
Idents(seu_int) <- seu_int$seurat_clusters
```

```{r}
table(seu_int$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r}
# find subclusters
seu_int.0 <- FindSubCluster(seu_int, 0, "integrated_snn", algorithm = 3,
                            resolution = 0.3)

seu_int.1 <- FindSubCluster(seu_int, 1, "integrated_snn", algorithm = 3,
                            resolution = 0.3)

seu_int.2 <- FindSubCluster(seu_int, 2, "integrated_snn", algorithm = 3,
                            resolution = 0.3)

seu_int.3 <- FindSubCluster(seu_int, 3, "integrated_snn", algorithm = 3,
                            resolution = 0.3)

seu_int.4 <- FindSubCluster(seu_int, 4, "integrated_snn", algorithm = 3,
                            resolution = 0.3)
```

```{r, fig.asp=1}
DimPlot(seu_int.0, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5,

DimPlot(seu_int.3, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5,

  bottom_legend

```

```{r}
table(seu_int.0$sub.cluster)
table(seu_int.1$sub.cluster)
table(seu_int.2$sub.cluster)
table(seu_int.3$sub.cluster)
table(seu_int.4$sub.cluster)
```

```{r}
# merge all the subcluster labels into one variable
seu_int$all_clusters <- as.character(seu_int$seurat_clusters)

seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "0",
                               seu_int.0$sub.cluster,
                               seu_int$all_clusters)
seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "1",
                                  seu_int.1$sub.cluster,
                                  seu_int$all_clusters)
seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "2",
                                  seu_int.2$sub.cluster,
                                  seu_int$all_clusters)
seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "3",
                                  seu_int.3$sub.cluster,
                                  seu_int$all_clusters)
seu_int$all_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$all_clusters == "4",
                                  seu_int.4$sub.cluster,
                                  seu_int$all_clusters)
table(seu_int$all_clusters)

length(unique(seu_int$all_clusters))
```

```{r}
object <- here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "Gerli_et_al_2024.Integrated_clustered.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # update the default clustering resolution to our chosen one
  seu_int$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seu_int$all_clusters)
  Idents(seu_int) <- seu_int$seurat_clusters
  
  saveRDS(seu_int, object)
} else {
  seu_int <- readRDS(object)
}
```

```{r}
ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS <- c(light.colors(n = 24), sky.colors(n = 13))
names(ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) <- levels(seu_int$seurat_clusters)
```

## Visualise the clustered dataset

### Cluster and sample

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend + blank_axes + ggtitle("Seurat Clusters")
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
             fill = seurat_clusters)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat='count', aes(label=..count..), vjust=-0.25) +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
  NoLegend() +
  ylim(0, 11000) +
  xlab("Seurat clusters") + rotate_x_labels +
  ylab("Number of cells") + ggtitle("Seurat Clusters")
```

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
             y = nCount_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "area") +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(color = seurat_clusters)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
  NoLegend() -> p1

seu_int@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
             y = nFeature_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "area") +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(color = seurat_clusters)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
  NoLegend() -> p2


p1 | p2
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}

p4 <- seu_int@meta.data %>%

p3 + p4
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting)]) +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Proportion of cells per gestational age by cell type") -> p2

p1 + p2
```
